question: What bodily and perceptual powers result from this wheel’s practice?
premises: The practice can destroy wrinkles and grey hair
The practice can grant seeing from very far away
These are presented as parallel attainments
inference: This practice brings the destruction of wrinkles and grey hair and the power of seeing from very far away.
plain_english: It brings the destruction of wrinkles and grey hair, and likewise the ability to see from very far away.
